whyItMatters: Cargo resolves these names against the registry, so a name that only looks like the intended crate compiles foreign code into the binary. The name this rule expects is `lazy_static`.
actions: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `lazy_static`, correct it to that exact spelling.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Cargo.toml no longer carries a declared crate name in Cargo.toml within one edit of `lazy_static`.
